## 问题解决

![image-20260906214828863](./assets/image-20260906214828863-1788857006008-40-1788857296150-142-1788858010124-40-1788858029206-40-1788858145467-142.png)

# AIRSIM

## 编译源码报错

![img](./assets/file-1788857006008-41-1788857296150-143-1788858010125-42-1788858029206-42-1788858145467-144.webp)

### 该报错是由于win11安全策略需要检查文件的数字签名

### 打开developer cmd后输入powershell进入powershell模式

![image-20260907031153222](./assets/image-20260907031153222-1788857006008-42-1788857296150-144-1788858010124-41-1788858029206-43-1788858145467-143.png)

### 依次执行如下指令，其中输入Get-ExecutionPolicy时，若显示RemoteSigned

### 则表示成功修改签名验证的相关策略

![image-20260907031248919](./assets/image-20260907031248919-1788857006008-43-1788857296150-145-1788858010125-43-1788858029206-41-1788858145467-146.png)

```
Set-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned
Get-ExecutionPolicy
exit
cd E:\Download\AirSim-1.8.1-windows(这里使用你自己的路径)
E:
build.cmd
```





## 示例工程报错

### 运行该文件后并未生成Plugins和Blocks.sln![image-20260907032902798](./assets/image-20260907032902798-1788857006008-44-1788857296151-146-1788858010125-44-1788858029206-44-1788858145467-145.png)

### 而是出现如图所示界面

![image.png](./assets/file-1788857006008-41-1788857296150-143-1788858010125-42-1788858029206-42-1788858145467-144.webp)

### 先双击此文件进行自动编译

![image-20260907032341562](./assets/image-20260907032341562-1788857006008-45-1788857296151-147-1788858010125-46-1788858029207-46-1788858145467-147.png)

### 会出现如下报错

![image-20260907031904890](./assets/image-20260907031904890-1788857006008-46-1788857296151-149-1788858010125-45-1788858029206-45-1788858145467-148.png)

### 用记事本打开（根据你自身路径决定）E:\epic\UE_4.27\Engine\Config\BaseEngine.ini

![image-20260908144622679](./assets/image-20260908144622679-1788857006008-47-1788857296151-148-1788858010125-47-1788858029207-47-1788858145467-149.png)

### 在文本文件的最末尾加上如下配置

```
[PlatformPaths]
UnrealBuildTool=Engine/Binaries/DotNET/UnrealBuildTool.exe
```

![image-20260907031835253](./assets/image-20260907031835253-1788857006009-48-1788857296151-150-1788858010125-48-1788858029207-48-1788858145467-150.png)

### 再次双击该文件将自动开始编译并生成文件

![image-20260907032341562](./assets/image-20260907032341562-1788857006008-45-1788857296151-147-1788858010125-46-1788858029207-46-1788858145467-147.png)

![image-20260908142326033](./assets/image-20260908142326033-1788857006009-49-1788857296151-153-1788858010125-50-1788858029207-49-1788858145467-151.png)

### 随后UE将会自动打开,进入该界面,即正常

![image-20260908142413364](./assets/image-20260908142413364-1788857006009-50-1788857296151-151-1788858010125-49-1788858029207-50-1788858145467-152.png)

### 此时再次运行此文件即可

![image-20260907032902798](./assets/image-20260907032902798-1788857006008-44-1788857296151-146-1788858010125-44-1788858029206-44-1788858145467-145.png)

### 会自动生成对应文件

![image-20260907033119125](./assets/image-20260907033119125-1788857006009-51-1788857296151-152-1788858010125-51-1788858029207-51-1788858145467-153.png)
